## WiFi Agent 1.4.0

This release makes WiFi Agent dependable on Linux, reconnects within seconds
when the portal ends a session, adds a tray icon and notifications on every
platform, ships native Linux packages, and fixes macOS installs that never
opened.

### Highlights

- **Linux no longer stops silently.** A missing or locked password vault is
  re-detected, reported in the tray and by notification, and on systems
  without a vault the password is kept in a private user-only file. The
  background service restarts itself and has a watchdog.
- **Fast recovery after portal logouts.** The portal's keep-alive reply is
  now understood, so WiFi Agent logs in again on the next check (every 10
  seconds while disconnected) and right after sleep or cable changes.
- **Tray icon and notifications.** A colour-coded tray icon on Linux (KDE,
  Cinnamon, XFCE, MATE, Ubuntu GNOME, Waybar, and more) and notifications on
  Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- **Linux packages** for Debian/Ubuntu (`.deb`) and Arch Linux.
- **macOS fixes.** The package always installs to `/Applications`, opening
  the app while it runs in the menu bar shows Settings, and startup errors are
  shown instead of failing silently.

### Downloads

- `WiFiAgent-1.4.0-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` — Windows 64-bit setup
- `WiFiAgent-1.4.0-macOS-arm64.pkg` / `.dmg` — Apple silicon Mac
- `WiFiAgent-1.4.0-macOS-x86_64.pkg` / `.dmg` — Intel Mac
- `wifi-agent_1.4.0_all.deb` — Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+ (`sudo apt install ./wifi-agent_1.4.0_all.deb`)
- `wifi-agent-1.4.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst` — Arch Linux (`sudo pacman -U wifi-agent-1.4.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst`)
- `PKGBUILD`, `wifi-agent.install`, `wifi-agent-1.4.0.tar.gz` — AUR packaging

### Upgrading

- Windows and macOS 1.3.0 users can update from **Check for updates**.
- Linux users on a source installation can install a package, or re-run
  `./install.sh`. If the password was stored in a vault that is no longer
  running, open WiFi Agent and enter it once more.

### Signing status

The repository does not currently have Apple Developer ID or Windows signing
certificates configured. On macOS, install with
`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akshajtiwari/Wifi-Agent/main/install-macos.sh | bash`
or allow the package under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open
Anyway**. Windows may display an unknown-publisher warning.
